name: Renaissance Scrub Prototype
author: Lyle Mills
description: A Renaissance-inspired continuous-LPC word player with unpatched frozen scanning, patched one-shot playback, and variable pitch prosody.

controls.label: Word
controls.description: Selects one of twelve host-generated words.

controls.label: Position
controls.description: Chooses the frozen frame when TRIG is unpatched and the one-shot start position when it is patched.

controls.label: Formant
controls.description: Shifts the apparent vocal-tract size without changing the played pitch.

controls.label: Prosody
controls.description: Sweeps continuously from flat pitch at counter-clockwise to the captured contour at clockwise.

outputs.main: Frozen LPC frame when TRIG is unpatched; one-shot word playback when patched.
outputs.aux: The matching LPC excitation signal before the vocal-tract filter.
